name: @w6w-apps/clicksend
description: Send SMS, MMS, voice calls and transactional email, and manage contact lists, via ClickSend.

w6w.longDescription:
ClickSend puts several outbound communication channels behind one account and one credential, and this app covers the ones a workflow is most likely to reach for: SMS, MMS, voice calls and transactional email, plus the contact lists that feed them.

Every send reports back what it actually cost — message parts, price, and per-recipient delivery status — so a workflow can see whether a longer message quietly split into extra billed segments, or whether one recipient in a batch failed while the rest went through, rather than assuming a single message and a single price for every send. Voice messages are read from text with a selectable language and voice, and a companion action lists which pairings ClickSend actually supports before a call is placed.

Bulk and campaign-oriented sending, fax, physical mail, and account administration aren't part of this app — it stays focused on sending a message and knowing what happened to it, and reading and building the contact lists a workflow sends to.
